product_overview: RubricLensAi is a public, no-login web app for pasting report text or uploading a PDF, customizing a weighted rubric, and getting AI-assisted evaluation. It returns an overall weighted score with criterion-level feedback, evidence, and recommendations.
core_goals: Enter a document as pasted text or PDF for analysis
Choose the appropriate document type and matching rubric template
Customize rubric criteria, weights, and applicability before analysis
Review AI-generated weighted scores, evidence, and recommendations
Access privacy and terms information without signing in

features.name: Document input
features.description: Users can provide report content by pasting text or uploading a PDF, then review the extracted readable text before analysis.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Paste report text into the document field -> Review the entered text -> Remove or replace the current document
Navigate to / -> Upload a PDF document -> See PDF extraction progress and warnings -> Review the extracted text -> Remove or replace the current document

features.name: Document type and rubric templates
features.description: Users can switch between supported document types and automatically receive the matching default rubric and guidance.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select a document type -> See the rubric change to the selected template -> Read the document-specific guidance and limits
Navigate to / -> Select a different document type -> See the rubric update to the new template -> Confirm the rubric now matches the chosen document type

features.name: Advanced rubric editing
features.description: Users can open advanced controls to tailor criteria, weights, descriptions, and applicability before running analysis.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter a document draft -> Open advanced rubric controls -> Edit criterion text and weight -> Mark a criterion as not applicable -> Let the tab draft save automatically -> Reload and review the restored draft
Navigate to / -> Open advanced rubric controls -> Add a criterion -> Remove a criterion -> Review the updated rubric
Navigate to / -> Open advanced rubric controls -> Enter an invalid weight or leave a criterion empty -> See validation feedback -> Correct the rubric and continue editing

features.name: Appendix handling
features.description: When an appendix is detected, users can decide whether it should be excluded from analysis.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter a document containing an appendix heading -> Confirm whether the appendix should be excluded -> Continue with the adjusted document
Navigate to / -> Enter a document containing an appendix heading -> Cancel the exclusion decision -> Return to editing the document

features.name: AI document analysis
features.description: Users can validate the current document and rubric, send them for AI analysis, and follow progress while the request is processed.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Provide a valid document and rubric -> Click the analyze button -> See analysis progress while waiting -> Receive the analysis result
Navigate to / -> Leave the document empty or the rubric invalid -> Click the analyze button -> See validation messages explaining what must be fixed -> Correct the input and try again
Navigate to / -> Start analysis with valid input -> See analysis progress -> Cancel or retry when a recoverable failure is shown

features.name: Weighted result review
features.description: Users can review the overall weighted score, criterion feedback, evidence, and recommendations after analysis completes.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Provide a valid document and rubric -> Request analysis -> Read the total score and summary -> Expand or review criterion-level feedback -> Read evidence and improvement recommendations
Navigate to / -> Review an analysis result -> Change the document or rubric -> Request a new analysis -> See the previous result replaced by the new one

features.name: Draft reset
features.description: Users can clear the current document and analysis state to start a fresh evaluation.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click the clear or start-over control -> Confirm the reset when prompted -> See the empty initial state

features.name: Legal information
features.description: Users can open privacy and terms pages to read browser-storage, data-processing, and service terms information without signing in.
user_flows: Navigate to /privacy -> Read browser-storage and data-processing disclosures -> Return to the document analyzer
Navigate to /terms -> Read the terms of service -> Return to the document analyzer
Navigate to / -> Open Privacy from the footer -> Read the privacy information -> Open Terms from the footer -> Return to the document analyzer

known_limitations.issue: Image-only scanned PDFs are not converted with OCR and may not contain usable text
known_limitations.impact: Users may need to paste text or provide a PDF with a readable text layer

known_limitations.issue: Multi-column PDF text extraction may not preserve the exact visual reading order
known_limitations.impact: Extracted text can require review before analysis

known_limitations.issue: The application intentionally stores no user account or long-term server-side document history
known_limitations.impact: Users cannot sign in or retrieve earlier analyses from another browser session
